The Lucky Spot, a new neighborhood bar from Highfield Hospitality, is officially open at 1431 Stockton Street in North Beach, San Francisco. The concept is the second from owner Barry John Walsh, following For The Record in the Marina, and is designed as an easygoing gathering place with an approachable cocktail program. The space features decor inspired by San Francisco's neighborhoods, sports history, and local culture.

Upside, a music-driven cocktail destination, is set to open on June 5 in Wynwood's Arts District at 59 NW 28th St. The venue will combine live music programming, visually driven interiors, and a cocktail-focused menu, with a culinary program led by Executive Chef Pablo Lamon, a Top Chef Season 16 competitor. The space is designed to transition from daytime gatherings into late-night experiences.

House Rules, an adult arcade and entertainment restaurant, is set to debut in the Rancho Charleston neighborhood of Las Vegas at 3071 S Rancho Dr, across from Area15. The concept originated as "Lane Park" in Scottsdale in 2023 and was rebranded in 2024 to offer a high-energy, upscale social gaming experience with a scratch-kitchen menu. The opening is anticipated sometime this year, per a City of Las Vegas permit.
